title: Kubernetes Workload Hardening

operatorSteps.title: Review Kubernetes assessment
operatorSteps.instruction: Review service, RBAC, service account, pod security, network policy, secret, host access, and resource-control findings.

operatorSteps.title: Plan Kubernetes control changes
operatorSteps.instruction: Draft a non-executing control plan for network policy, least-privilege RBAC, service-account hardening, pod security, and resource limits.

operatorSteps.title: Record reassessment command
operatorSteps.instruction: Record the manifest reassessment command to run after approved changes are applied.

recommendedControls: Replace external service exposure with approved ingress or internal service patterns.
Remove cluster-admin role bindings from application workloads.
Set automountServiceAccountToken=false unless API access is required.
Disable privileged containers, host namespace access, and root execution.
Add default-deny NetworkPolicy and explicit allow rules.
Set CPU and memory requests and limits.
Remove hostPath and container runtime socket mounts.
nonClaims: This playbook does not connect to a cluster.
This playbook does not execute kubectl.
This playbook does not apply manifests.
This playbook does not authorize live remediation.
